labels.look: White, rows in Direct/Indirect Black and Thin ('BODY IN MOTION', 'DESIGN INDABA'), each with a style dropdown and size slider; cut runs on into 'DANCE!', story, video and poster
labels.ux: Per-row style picker and size slider; variable row adds weight and space sliders
labels.learn: Fill the tester rows with words from the font's own story (the dancer, the event) so testing also tells it

labels.variantDefinition: Every style labelled and shown as the same paragraph of running text, stacked in weight order, to compare texture at reading size
labels.look: Light grey, name and Korean word top, then 'Thin (100)' to 'Bold (700)' labels each over the same Hangul paragraph
labels.learn: Repeat one paragraph in every weight: for a CJK or text face, colour on the page matters more than display words

labels.look: Coral, white lines stepping from condensed to wide ('Slightly Squared' … 'Full Of Features'), one slider on top, row of VW-bus dingbats
labels.ux: One weight slider drives all four lines; each line is editable
labels.learn: Make each tester line a selling point set in a different width, so the copy and the range arrive together

labels.look: Charcoal band, two lines of condensed grey text with light-blue underlined links
labels.ux: Links to the design system and to the making-of article
labels.learn: Two sentences and two links can carry the context (part of a city design system) without a full story section

labels.variantDefinition: A signed preface by the commissioner or publisher explaining why the typeface was commissioned, set like a book foreword
labels.look: Mint green, small centred 'Foreword' title, narrow column of small serif prose, two signatures (institution heads)
labels.learn: A commissioner's foreword frames a public typeface as cultural heritage, not a product

labels.variantDefinition: A carousel of slides, each pairing one design decision (a glyph detail, the weight range) with a large visual and a short witty caption
labels.look: Yellow alphabet panel left, dark panel right with teal heading 'Seven weights', red and teal buttons; cookie notice and sticky nav overlap
labels.ux: Prev/next through slides ('Going for the tittle', 'Counter attack'); weight slider on the first slide
labels.learn: Title each design note with a football phrase: a running theme makes glyph trivia memorable

labels.variantDefinition: Long-form chronological history of the genre or model, illustrated with archival ads, specimens and objects from each era, ending with the revival
labels.look: Butter yellow, giant black 'History.' headline, serif column with portrait, then 1896 bicycle ad, wood type, 1970s Pentel and ravioli ads
labels.ux: Read and scroll; a small editable sample near the end
labels.learn: Trace the style through period ads across a century so the revival feels like the next chapter

labels.variantDefinition: A pinned, scroll-scrubbed illustration, often mirrored into a symmetric pattern, that opens like doors between sections; pure transition, no text
labels.look: Flat tan, orange, violet and white architectural motif (beams, arches, sun) mirrored four ways
labels.ux: Lottie canvas plays as you scroll ~1500px while pinned
labels.learn: A scroll-driven 'door' between chapters adds ceremony and pacing without a word of copy

labels.look: Beige, light panels per feature (styles, small caps, Cyrillic, Greek, localisation, figures…) with green labels and dark red highlighted glyphs
labels.ux: Each panel has an 'info ▼' expander explaining how to access the feature
labels.learn: Pair every feature panel with a hidden how-to note: the catalogue stays visual and still answers 'how do I use it?'
